messages:
Ava: quick follow-up from the postmortem — putting a short remediation plan here for rollout/canary improvements.
Ben: main failure recap: unscoped flag + fast ramp + no immediate fallback. agree we need safer defaults + auto-containment.
Camila: propose defaults: sample_scope=org_tag, default_sample_pct=1, ramp windows [5,15,60] mins, block >10% without manual approval.
Drew: runtime detector idea: two-signal rule (ewma error 3m + p95 latency multiplier 1.5x). require 2 signals to pause canary.
Ava: auto-rollback policy: if pause persists >10m OR error_rate jumps >5% in 3m after pause -> rollback. page only on rollback, slack on pause.
Ben: SDK change: add fallback_variant + max_tokens_per_request per-flag so clients can flip locally when paused. I'll own the PR. ETA 2025-05-04.
Camila: infra: I'll build a lightweight canary_health metric and detector. ETA 2025-05-06.
Drew: sim: I'll write a small replay script to validate thresholds (`eng-platform/tools/canary_replay.sh`). ETA 2025-05-05.
ops-bot: [card] PM-6200 created: "canary-containment & flag defaults" assigned.
Ava: action items recap: Ben -> SDK PR (2025-05-04); Camila -> detector + dashboard (2025-05-06); Drew -> sim harness (2025-05-05); Ava -> console quarantine UI spec + runbook (2025-05-08).
Camila: policy note: require signed approval to set scope=global. default to org_tag in CI templates.
Ben: also recommend monthly audit for flags with exposure_count >1 in 90d. tag owners automatically.
Ava: sample guard rule to store in config: { "flag_id":"nlp-route-v2","scope":"org_tag","tag":"beta","sample_pct":1,"ramp_minutes":[5,15,60],"auto_pause":{"ewma_mins":3,"err_pct":2,"latency_mult":1.5},"auto_rollback":{"pause_mins":10} }
Drew: small safety: prevent ramps above 10% without manual opt-in. simple and effective.
Ava: thanks all — check-in next week to review staging sims. :thumbsup:
